title: List your business
intro1: Pana MIA is a directory of South Florida's independent makers, shops, artists and small businesses. Getting listed is free.
intro2: Tell us the basics — it takes about a minute. No account needed yet.
step2Body: A real person reviews every submission so the directory stays local and legit.
step3Body: Once you're live, we email you a link to claim it and fill out the rest.
formDesc: Only the starred fields are required. You can add everything else after you claim your listing.
emailNote: Use the address you want to claim this listing with — we'll send the claim link here.
fiveWordsNote: A few words. This is what people see first in the directory.
linksNote: Add at least one so we can confirm you're a real local business.
detailsPlaceholder: Tell us a bit more about what you make, where you're based, or what makes you you.
phoneNote: Only used by our team if we need to reach you. Never shown publicly.
turnstileBlocked: Verification could not load. Please refresh the page and try again.
turnstileNote: Protected by Cloudflare Turnstile. No tracking, no cookies.
successBody: We've received your listing and sent a confirmation to {{email}}.
successNext1: Our team reviews your submission, usually within a few days.
successNext2: Once approved, your listing goes live in the directory.
successNext3: We'll email you a link to claim it and add photos, hours and more.
